title: Split read-only progress view modules
summary: Extracted the read-only Diagnostics progress projection from the Progress WebView facade into a child module while preserving the existing public namespace and function exports.
reason: Reduce the size and responsibility concentration of progressView.js without changing backend ownership, mutation behavior, or operator-visible progress semantics.
behavior_before: progressView.js contained the Diagnostics progress row projection, status classification, summary text, and rendering implementation alongside unrelated progress views.
behavior_after: progress/diagnostics.js owns the read-only Diagnostics progress implementation; progressView.js wires it into the unchanged mediaPipelineProgressView public facade.
manual_validation: git diff --check for the refactor path set - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the progress/diagnostics.js script include and restore the extracted implementation to progressView.js; no backend, runtime-state, or media files are changed by this refactor.
